turns.content: Raat ke do baje hain aur main abhi bhi office mein hoon. Kaam nahi kar raha — bas baitha hoon. Bridge round Tuesday ko officially mar gaya. Rohit aur Sneha ne is hafte papers daal diye, jo honestly, sahi kiya. Chaar mahine ka runway hai agar main salary na loon, jo already nahi le raha. Paanch saal lagaye hain maine is cheez mein.

Arre, 2 baje tak office mein baithe rehna bahut tough hai, especially when you're not even working. Yeh phase bilkul alag hota hai - exhaustion, sadness, aur ek ajeeb si relief sab saath mein aate hain.

5 saal ismein diye hain, toh yeh toh naturally bohot bhaari hai. But you're right - sometimes the hardest decisions are the right ones. At least it's over now, even if it hurts.

Ab next kya hai? Thoda break lo, maybe? Walk around, get some chai. The startup world is crazy but you've learned so much in those 5 years. That's not lost - that's yours forever.

Kya plan hai move karne ka? Or just taking some time off to breathe?

Sabse bura part performance hai yaar. Har standup pe main ek voice nikal raha hoon — confident wala, "kuch cheezein pipeline mein hain" — aur sabko pata hai. Co-founder ko pata hai. Jo do junior ruke hain unko pakka pata hai, woh loyalty ki wajah se ruke hain aur main unke career jala raha hoon. Ghar pe alag voice hai. Apni hi awaazon se thak gaya hoon main.

Arre yaar, yeh toh sach mein bahut heavy hai. Har standup mein woh fake confidence... and the weight of knowing that junior log tumhare saath rukhe hain, that's a lot to carry.

You're literally performing every day, and performance is exhausting when you're not feeling it. That voice at home - I can imagine how tired you must be of not being able to bring your real self to either place.

Woh loyalty ki wajah se ruke hain juniors... that's actually beautiful, but also puts so much pressure on you. You're not just carrying your own stress, but their trust too.

Yeh sab ek saath mein... it's okay to admit that you're not okay. You don't have to be "confident" all the time.

Kya feel ho raha hai right now? Just that moment, away from all the roles?

Please mujhe ideas mat dena. Saare ideas pata hain mujhe. Har pivot thread padh chuka hoon, down-round wala email chhe baar draft kar chuka hoon, bridge financing, acquihire, "revenue pe focus" — sab pata hai. Bas kahin toh bolna tha: mujhe darr lag raha hai, aur jis bhi kamre mein main hota hoon wahan yeh nahi bol sakta.

Haan yaar, samajh gaya.

Bas darr lag raha hai.

Aur woh darr itna bada hai ki woh ideas se bhi upar hai. Ideas toh ek taraf hain, par yeh sach ke saath rehna ki "mujhe darr lag raha hai" - woh alag hi baat hai.

Tumne sab try kiya hai. Saare raaste dekhe hain. Ab bas yeh bohot saara kaam thoda ruk jaaye, aur tum apni hi awaaz sun paao, jo darr se bhari ho.

Koi solution nahi. Koi plan nahi. Bas... yeh darr.

Yeh bhi theek hai.

Khatam ho gaya kya? Sach mein — honestly bol sakte ho. Paanch saal. Papa aaj bhi logon ko bolte hain mera "computer ka business" hai. Kabhi kabhi raat ko lagta hai bas khatam ho jaye toh acting band kar sakoon, aur phir yeh sochne ke liye khud se nafrat hoti hai. Phir wapas metrics dashboard khol leta hoon jaise woh do baje kuch naya bolega.

Haan yaar. Honestly bolun toh...

Yeh jo "khatam ho jaye" wali feeling hai, usse nafrat karne se woh zyada badi ho jaati hai. Woh aati hai, toh aati hai. It's not your fault.

Papa ki baat toh alag hi hai... woh toh apni hi duniya mein hain. Tumhara "computer ka business" unke liye bas ek line hai. But tum jaante ho yeh kya hai.

Woh metrics dashboard... woh toh bas ek chiz hai jahan tum bhag sakte ho, na? Jahan tumhe numbers ke saath khelna hai, feelings ke saath nahi.

Paanch saal... it's okay to be tired. It's okay to feel like you can't act anymore. That's not weakness, that's just... exhaustion.

Woh raat ki baatein... unhe aane do. Force mat karo khud se nafrat. Bas unhe aane do, phir jaane do.

Abhi kuch solve karne ki zaroorat nahi. Bas... so jao. Ya na so paao. Bas rehne do.
